section.title: Security & Sovereignty
section.purpose: Protect tenant isolation, secrets, data handling, ownership, export and recovery.

questions.title: Tenant isolation
questions.prompt: How must this client's data be isolated from every other client?
questions.recommendation: Default to a separate tenant/namespace with explicit grants.

questions.title: Roles / permissions
questions.prompt: What user roles exist and what may each access or change?
questions.recommendation: Map human authority before agent authority.

questions.title: Authentication
questions.prompt: What identity provider, MFA, SSO or account controls are required?

questions.title: Compliance
questions.prompt: What legal, contractual, regulatory, insurance or customer requirements apply?
questions.recommendation: Do not infer obligations solely from industry.

questions.title: Retention / deletion
questions.prompt: How long should data, logs, recordings, prompts and artifacts be retained?

questions.title: Model / data policy
questions.prompt: Which model providers may receive which classes of company data?

questions.title: Secrets
questions.prompt: Where are API keys, tokens, passwords and certificates stored and rotated?
questions.recommendation: Never copy secrets into prompts, repos or knowledge files.

questions.title: Backups
questions.prompt: What must be backed up before integration or migration work?

questions.title: Incident authority
questions.prompt: Who can stop automation, revoke access or declare an incident?
questions.recommendation: There must be a human kill-switch owner.
